name: Yampa River — Deerlodge Park and Yampa Canyon
gaugeName: Yampa River at Deerlodge Park, CO (USGS 09260050)
blurb: Lower Yampa into Dinosaur National Monument: the approach to Deerlodge Park and the permitted multi-day Yampa Canyon trip to Split Mountain, UT.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Mileage: CPW Yampa River State Park river sections.

notices.title: Deerlodge takeout permit
notices.text: NPS requires a play permit for trips entering from above Deerlodge and taking out there. Contact the River Permit Office to confirm arrangements; NPS recommends arriving after 2 pm to avoid congestion. Continuing below Deerlodge requires the appropriate canyon trip permit.
notices.sourceName: NPS Dinosaur NM 'Boating and Rafting' page (re-fetched 2026-10-26)

sections.notes: NPS river permit required for all trips (Recreation.gov 250014). Warm Springs rapid. Take-out is in Utah. Mileage: NPS Dinosaur NM 'Boating in the Monument' 2025.

guideTimes.conditions: NPS normal permitted high-use-season trip length (5 days/4 nights); an itinerary allocation, not hours afloat; overlength by one day only on rare occasions
guideTimes.sourceName: NPS Dinosaur NM 'Boating in the Monument' 2025

notices.title: Dinosaur river permit
notices.text: A river permit is required for the Yampa Canyon trip. Check NPS and Recreation.gov for the applicable season, lottery dates, fees and trip-length limits.

notices.title: Permit
notices.text: NPS: play permits are required for boating upstream of the Gates of Lodore or Deerlodge Park boat ramps and for downstream travel from the Split Mountain Boat Ramp; groups launching above Deerlodge must stop at Deerlodge for boater check-in before continuing on a permitted trip.
notices.sourceName: NPS Dinosaur NM 'Boating and Rafting' page (re-fetched 2026-10-26)
